dashboard_erro: The indicators could not be calculated. See the log for details.
permissao_negada: You do not have permission to see this information.

insight_concluidas_periodo: {quantidade} task(s) completed in the last {dias} days.

insight_anomalia: Unusual day on {dia}: {valor} completions, far from the norm.

conta_inativa: This account is disabled. Ask an administrator.
conta_bloqueada: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutos} minute(s).
primeiro_administrador_texto: This is the first run. Create the account that will administer this installation — there is no default password.
senha_requisitos: At least {minimo} characters, and not only digits.
senha_invalida: The password does not meet the requirements.
senha_com_espacos_nas_pontas: The password cannot start or end with spaces.
senha_so_digitos: The password cannot be only digits.
senha_contem_utilizador: The password cannot contain the username.
senha_repetitiva: The password cannot be a single repeated character.
selecione_conta: Select an account from the list.
utilizador_erro: The operation could not be completed.
utilizador_ja_existe: An account with that username already exists.
utilizador_nome_invalido: Invalid username: 3 to 32 characters, letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'.
utilizador_ultimo_admin: This is the last active administrator account: the operation would leave the installation with nobody able to manage it.
confirmar_terminar_sessao: Sign out and close the application?
tarefa_de_outro: This task belongs to someone else and cannot be changed by you.
plugin_sem_permissoes: None — this plugin does not access your data.
plugin_permissao_nao_declarada: The plugin tried to do something it did not request permission for.
mover_para: Where {unidade} goes, with everything below it:
sem_destinos: There is nowhere to move it: a company is always top level.
estrutura_vazia: No structure yet. Create a company to start organising departments and teams. Until then, everything works as before.
organizacao_erro: The structure could not be changed.
unidade_nome_duplicado: A unit with that name already exists here.
unidade_estrutura_invalida: That change would leave the structure invalid.
unidade_com_conteudo: The unit has sub-units. Move or remove them first.
backup_o_que_leva: A backup keeps tasks, accounts, the company structure, the audit trail, settings and plugin data. It does not keep the plugins themselves: a backup file travels by e-mail and on USB sticks, and restoring must never be a way to install code.
backup_criar_ajuda: Writes everything to a ZIP file of your choice. Keep it off this machine.
backup_restaurar_ajuda: Replaces the current data with the backup's. The current state is saved first, so you can go back.
backup_restaurar_aviso: This replaces the current data. The current state is saved to an emergency copy before anything is touched. Continue?
backup_plugins_registados: Plugins at the time: {plugins} (restoring does not install them).
backup_restaurado: Data restored. The previous state is in {caminho}
backup_reiniciar: Close and reopen the application to work on the restored data.
backup_invalido: This file is not a valid backup.
backup_incompativel: This backup was made by a newer version of the application.
funcionalidades_ajuda: What this installation includes. This is not the same as permissions: permissions say what each person may do, this says what exists at all. Turning a feature off hides it from everyone, administrators included.
funcionalidades_reiniciar: Saved. Close and reopen the application to see the change.
funcionalidade_desligada: This feature is turned off in this installation.
funcionalidade_painel_ajuda: The tab with indicators, charts and trends. Tasks keep working without it.
funcionalidade_relatorios_ajuda: Generating and exporting reports as CSV, XLSX and PDF.
funcionalidade_estrutura_ajuda: The screen where companies, departments and teams are drawn. Turning it off does not change who sees what: the existing structure still applies.
automacoes_ajuda: When something happens, and if the conditions hold, the application does the rest. Actions run with your permissions: a rule does not let you do what you cannot do by hand.
automacoes_vazio: No rules yet. For example: when an item falls below its minimum, create a task to order it.
se_ajuda: Event field, comparison and value. Left blank, the rule always applies.
texto_da_acao_ajuda: You can use {campo} to insert event data — for example: Order item {id}.
sem_acoes: There are no actions available, so a rule could not do anything.
pesquisa_ajuda: Type at least {minimo} letters. Searches tasks, the company structure, and whatever the installed modules know how to search.
importar_resumo: {aceites} row(s) will be imported, {problemas} left out.
importar_nada_entra: No row can be imported. Check the column mapping.
importar_concluida: Imported {criados} row(s). {problemas} did not go in.
importar_sem_destinos: There is nowhere to import to with your permissions.
importacao_ilegivel: The file could not be read.
importacao_vazio: The file has no rows to import.
importacao_perigoso: This file was refused for safety reasons.
funcionalidade_segregacao_de_funcoes_aju: Stops whoever creates a task from being the one who marks it done. Turn it on only where someone else can close the work: with it on, nobody completes the tasks they created — not even an administrator.
politica_quem_cria_nao_conclui: Whoever creates a task cannot mark it done. Ask someone else to close it.
politica_falhou: An access rule could not be evaluated, so the action was refused. Check the application log.
plugin_repor_confirmar:

These plugins' settings and data are preserved. Continue?
plugin_repor_nada: The plugins that shipped with the application are already as they should be.
plugin_repostos: {quantos} plugin(s) restored to the version that shipped with the application.
aparencia_ao_reabrir: The application will use {modo} mode next time you open it.
acao_notificar: Notify whoever is using the application
